landing.title: A tiny todo list, secured by Huia
landing.intro: This sample signs in against the todo tenant of the Huia identity provider and stores tasks in a separate resource API using the issued access token.
landing.hint: Sign in with a seeded account (alice{'@'}todo.test / Password1!) or register a new one, or use passwordless phone sign-in.
